label: Lip products
description: Leave-on products applied to the lips: lipstick, balm, lip liner.

label: Deodorants & body sprays
description: Leave-on products applied to the axillae: deodorant, antiperspirant, fragranced body sprays/mists.

label: Eye / facial cleansers
description: Hydroalcoholic products on shaved skin: eye products, men's facial creams, facial cleansers, exfoliants.

label: Fine fragrance
description: Hydroalcoholic products on unshaved skin: perfumes, eaux de toilette, body creams, body oils, hair styling, hair sprays.

label: Body lotion
description: Leave-on body lotions and oils (excluding baby).

label: Face cream
description: Leave-on face cream, facial make-up, masks.

label: Hand cream
description: Leave-on hand cream, baby powder/talc, refreshing tissues for face/neck/body.

label: Baby cream
description: Baby cream, baby oil, baby talc.

label: Oral / lip
description: Mouthwash, toothpaste — oral and lip exposure.

label: Leave-on hair
description: Hair styling, hair gels, leave-in hair conditioners.

label: Anogenital exposure
description: Significant anogenital exposure: tampons, intimate wipes, toilet paper.

label: Rinse-off body
description: Body wash, soap, shower gel — body & hand rinse-off.

label: Feminine hygiene / wipes
description: Products with intended skin contact but minimal transfer: feminine hygiene, cleaning wipes.

label: Insect repellent (skin)
description: Insect repellents, sunscreens (skin-applied) with minimal transfer.

label: No skin contact
description: Products not intended for direct skin contact, minimal/insignificant transfer: candles, laundry detergents, room fragrances.
